summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K reporting an on-market share repurchase of 488,861 ordinary shares at an average price of 10.9289 GBP per share, acquired from JP Morgan Securities plc. The shares are intended to be cancelled, reducing share count. The repurchase was executed under shareholder authority from the 2025 AGM and a pre-arranged buyback program announced on 6 January 2026. This is a routine capital return via open-market purchases, not an issuer tender offer. The filing provides aggregated trade data by venue. Watch for continuation of the program and impact on EPS.
